title: Zesty Indulgent Slovakian Cabbage Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring savoy cabbage and nuka-pickle, these dumplings are resinous, springy, and indulgent, perfect for a hearty dinner. This recipe is nut-free-friendly, making it accessible to those with nut allergies.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped savoy cabbage and nuka-pickle, mixing well to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, and melted butter to form a smooth dough.
Add the salt and black pepper to the dough, mixing until well combined.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, shaping each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, placing a tablespoon of the cabbage mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a half-moon shape and pressing the edges together to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, gently adding the dumplings to the pot.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon, serving hot with your favorite toppings.
